void_date.description: Date the check is automatically voided

allow_overdraft.description: Allow the account to go negative for the transfer. The bank account needs to have `is_overdraftable` enabled with an overdraft reserve account linked to it.

amount.description: Amount (in cents) to clear. If not provided, the original transfer amount is used.

currency_code.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., `USD`).

deactivate_cards_and_card_tokens.description: When `true`, automatically deactivates all cards and their card tokens before closing the account. When `false` or omitted, the request fails if any cards are not already deactivated.

narrative.description: Free-text reason for closing the dispute.
narrative.example: The cardholder withdrew the dispute after the merchant issued a refund.

resolution.description: Whether the platform accepts the cardholder's claim and assumes liability, or the cardholder withdrew the claim.

Counterparty.description: A counterparty is an external account that you can transfer money to and from. All ACH and Wire transfers originated by Column take in a `counterparty_id` to identify the transfer destination. Once you have created a counterparty, you can send money to it (or pull from it)! A counterparty stores an external bank account and can also store additional transaction details, as desired or required. Read about counterparties in our data model section for more information.

account_number.description: The account number for the bank account.

account_type.description: The type of the account number. Can be `checking`, `savings`, `general_ledger`, or `loan`.

address.description: Addresses need to adhere to character validation, as addresses are used across multiple payment rails. Characters are validated according to the Fedwire character validation.

created_at.description: The timestamp the object was created.

description.description: Description of the counterparty visible only in your platform. Maximum length: `127` characters.

email.description: The email address of the beneficiary.

id.description: The unique ID of the object

is_column_account.description: Indicates whether this counterparty account is actually a Column account.

legal_id.description: The legal ID (e.g., Tax ID, Cedula Juridica, etc.) of the beneficiary. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: `127` characters.

legal_type.description: The legal entity type of the beneficiary. Can be `business`, `non_profit`, `individual`, or `sole_proprietor`. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries.

local_account_number.description: The local account number (e.g. Cuenta Cliente in Costa Rica) in the beneficiary's bank. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: 63 characters.

local_bank_code.description: The local bank code of the beneficiary's bank (e.g., India IFSC, Australia BSB, China CNAPS, etc.). This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: `63` characters.

local_bank_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code of the beneficiary's bank.

local_bank_name.description: Name of the beneficiary's local bank.

name.description: The counterparty name who owns the bank account. There is a `127` character limit for this field. For domestic wires, only the first 35 characters are included in the wire message.

phone.description: The phone number of the beneficiary. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: `31` characters.

routing_number.description: The routing number of the bank.

routing_number_type.description: The type of the routing number. Can be `aba`, `bic`, or `other`.

updated_at.description: The timestamp the object was last updated.

wire_drawdown_allowed.description: Whitelists counterparties for automatic approval of drawdown requests to Column via Fedwire. If `false`, all inbound drawdown requests from this counterparty will require explicit approval.

ach_company_id.description: The ACH Company ID for the rule. This is a ten digit identifier.

amount.description: the amount threshold in cents that will be used in rule evaluation. Must not be set if `amount_condition` is set to `ANY_AMOUNT`

amount_condition.description: This required field configures the rule to make a specific kind of amount comparison. equal: The incoming debit will only be permitted if the transfer amount equals the rule amount. `less_than_or_equal_to`: The incoming debit will only be permitted if the transfer amount is less than or equal to the rule amount. `any_amount`: The incoming debit will be permitted for any amount.

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account this rule applies to

description.description: Description of the rule. Maximum length: `255` characters.

addenda.description: Addenda information for the return. Maximum length: `44` characters.

date_of_death.description: Date (format: `YYYY-MM-DD`) of the account holder's or representative payee's death. Required by Nacha in the return addenda for return codes `R14` and `R15`, and rejected for any other return code.

description.description: Description for the return. Maximum length: `255` characters.

return_code.description: The ACH return reason code (e.g. R01, R02, etc.)

CreateAccountNumberParams.description: An account number is the child of a bank account. A bank account can have one or more account numbers. Think of account numbers as a pointer to a bank account. Account numbers will be used by external banks to transact with Column bank accounts.

check_issuing_manual_settlement_required.description: Whether manual settlement is required for check issuing. Only available when check issuing NSF grace period is enabled on the platform.

check_issuing_positive_pay_required.description: Whether check issuing positive pay is required for this account number

check_issuing_prefund_required.description: Whether prefund is required for check issuing. Omit to inherit the platform default.

description.description: A description for this account number

account_number_id.description: ID of the account number from which the transfer is sent. If no `account_number_id` is specified, the default account number on a provided `bank_account_id` is used. `account_number_id` or `bank_account_id` is required.

allow_overdraft.description: Allow the account to go negative for the transfer. The bank account needs to have `is_overdraftable` enabled with an overdraft reserve account linked to it.

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of the funds that will be transferred between originator and counterparty accounts. e.g. $1.75 would be represented by 175. A `0` amount creates a non-monetary entry: with `payment_related_info` on a CCD/CTX credit it is a zero-dollar remittance (transaction code 24/34); without `payment_related_info` it is a prenotification (prenote, transaction codes 23/28/33/38) used to validate the counterparty account before live entries. Both require the corresponding feature to be enabled for your platform, and prenotes are not supported for IAT. A non-monetary entry requires an explicit `0`; omitting the field is invalid.

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account from which the transfer is sent. If no `account_number_id` is specified, the default account number on the `bank_account_id` is used. `account_number_id` or `bank_account_id` is required.

company_discretionary_data.description: This optional field allows you to include codes (one or more), of significance only to you, to enable specialized handling of the transfer. There is no standardized interpretation for the value of the field. Maximum length: `20` characters.

company_entry_description.description: You can use this optional field to provide the Receiver with a description of the purpose of the transfer. Default value: `PAYMENT`. Maximum length: `10` characters.

company_name.description: This optional field identifies the source of the transfer and is used for descriptive purposes for the Receiver. Default value: the root entity name of your platform, or "COLUMN NA" if no root entity exists. Maximum length: `16` characters.

counterparty.description: Counterparty object to create a counterparty for the receiver of the transfer at transfer creation. Either counterparty or `counterparty_id` is required.

counterparty_id.description: ID of the counterparty that will receive the transfer. Either counterparty or `counterparty_id` is required.

currency_code.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217. e.g. `USD`

description.description: Description of the transfer visible only in your platform. Maximum length: `255` characters.

effective_date.description: Date (format: `YYYY-MM-DD` ) on which the transfer will be effective

entry_class_code.description: Standard Entry Class code of the transfer. Valid values: `CCD`, `CTX`, `CIE`, `PPD`, `TEL`, `WEB`.

hold.description: Create the transfer held instead of submitting it. Nothing is batched or sent until it is cleared; the effective date and same-day eligibility are decided when the transfer is cleared. For credits the amount is locked out of the available balance while held; a held debit locks nothing, since an outgoing debit pulls funds in at settlement.

intermediate_financial_institutions.description: List of intermediary financial institutions involved in an IAT (International ACH Transaction) transfer.

payment_related_info.description: Provides an additional `80` characters to give details on the ACH transaction for outgoing transfers. This information will be surfaced to the RDFI.

receiver_id.description: This field contains the accounting reference number by which the Receiver is known to the Originator. It is included for further identification and for descriptive purposes. Maximum length: `15` characters.

receiver_name.description: The name of the receiver, usually the name on the bank account of the Receiver. If omitted, counterparty.name will be automatically used. Default value: beneficiary name of the counterparty. Maximum length: `22` characters for all entry class codes except CIE it is 15 characters.

same_day.description: Specify if the transfer is a same-day ACH transfer. If it is set as `true`, it takes precedence over `effective_date` and overrides it.

transaction_type_code.description: This is a required code on IAT transfers used to identify reason for payment. Possible values: `ANN`, `BUS`, `DEP`, `LOA`, `MIS`, `MOR`, `PEN`, `REM`, `RLS`, `SAL`, `TAX`.

type.description: ACH transfer type: `CREDIT` or `DEBIT`. [Learn more]({{ach}}).

ultimate_beneficiary_counterparty.description: Counterparty object to create an ultimate beneficiary counterparty at the time of transfer creation. This is only required on outgoing IAT debits. Either `ultimate_beneficiary_counterparty` or `ultimate_beneficiary_counterparty_id` is required.

ultimate_beneficiary_counterparty_id.description: ID of the ultimate beneficiary counterparty that will receive the transfer. This is only required on outgoing IAT debits. Either `ultimate_beneficiary_counterparty` or `ultimate_beneficiary_counterparty_id` is required.

ultimate_originator_counterparty.description: Counterparty object to create an ultimate originator counterparty at the time of transfer creation. This is only required on outgoing IAT credits. Either `ultimate_originator_counterparty` or `ultimate_originator_counterparty_id` is required.

ultimate_originator_counterparty_id.description: ID of the ultimate originating counterparty that will sent the transfer. This is only required on outgoing IAT credits. Either `ultimate_originator_counterparty` or `ultimate_originator_counterparty_id` is required.

currency_code.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this bank account. Availability of non-USD currencies depends on your platform configuration. Defaults to `USD` if not set.

description.description: A name for the bank account (minimum: 3 characters)

display_name.description: The display name for the bank account. Display name is an account nickname used on Column's Dashboard.

entity_id.description: The entity ID of the owner

fdic_insurance.description: The type of FDIC insurance offered on this account. The default value is `standard`.

interest_config_id.description: The ID of interest config for this account. If it is not set, the default interest config of your platform will be used for this account. Please contact our support team for more details.

is_interest_bearing.description: Whether your platform needs to accrue and pay interest to this account. Please contact our support team for more details.

is_overdraftable.description: Whether the account can be overdrafted, must include an `overdraft_reserve_account_id`

overdraft_reserve_account_id.description: The overdraft reserve account that this account is linked to. If `is_overdraftable`: `true` then this field is required.

allow_overdraft.description: Allow the account to go negative for the transfer. The bank account needs to have `is_overdraftable` enabled with an overdraft reserve account linked to it.

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of the funds that will be transferred between sender and receiver accounts. e.g. $1.75 would be represented by 175.

currency_code.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217. e.g. `USD`.

description.description: A description of the transfer visible in account statements.

details.description: Additional monitoring details for the book transfer, used for compliance and reporting purposes.

hold.description: If set to `true`, the transfer will be created in a `HOLD` status instead of completing immediately.

receiver_account_number_id.description: ID of the account number that will receive the transfer.

receiver_bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account that will receive the transfer.

sender_account_number_id.description: ID of the account number that is sending the transfer.

sender_bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account that is sending the transfer.

account_usage.description: Indicates possible uses of the accounts an entity may use at Column. Only required for a root entity.

address.description: The physical address where the business operates. Addresses need to adhere to character validation, as addresses are used across multiple payment rails. Characters are validated according to the Fedwire character validation. Required by default.

collected_at.description: Field collection timestamps, keyed by field path (for example, `business_name` or `ein`). Values must be RFC3339 timestamps between `1900-01-01T00:00:00Z` and the current time. An empty map records no timestamps. Nested beneficial owner fields do not support `collected_at`; attest beneficial owners separately as person entities. Idempotency replays return the original resource without re-applying timestamps.

countries_of_operation.description: Countries in which the business currently operates or expects to operate. Only ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 Country Codes (e.g., `US`, `FR`, `UK`, `DE`, ... ) are allowed. Only required for a root entity.

country_of_incorporation.description: Country in which the business is incorporated. ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 Country Code.

date_of_incorporation.description: Date on which the business was incorporated. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

dba_name.description: Doing Business As name, if different from the legal business name.

description.description: Description of the business entity. Only required for a root entity.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (Tax ID). This may be SSN for a sole proprietorship. At least one form of business identification (`ein` or `registration_id`) is required unless `ein_pending` is set to `true`.

ein_pending.description: Set to `true` if the business has applied for an EIN but has not yet received it. When `true`, `ein` and `registration_id` must not be provided. Cannot be `true` for root entities.

end_customer_type.description: Type of end customer the business serves. Accepts a free-form string.

expected_payment_rails.description: Expected transaction types for the account. Comma-separated list of payment rails; each value must be one of: `ach`, `wire`, `swift`, `check`, `rtp`, `card_spend`.

expected_use_of_funds.description: Expected use of funds for the business accounts. Accepts a free-form string.

has_virtual_address.description: Indicates whether the business uses a virtual address.

industry.description: Industry in which the business entity operates.

is_high_risk.description: Indicates whether the entity has been identified as high risk based on compliance screening

is_root.description: Whether this entity is going to be a root entity of the platform. Root entities have special requirements and validation rules.

legal_type.description: Type of business. Permitted values are `limited-partnership`, `trust`, `sole-proprietorship`, `corporation`, `llc`, `general-partnership`, `professional-association`, `government`, `non-profit`, `other`, `pic-piv`, `spv`, `irrevocable_trust`, `revocable_trust`.

makes_international_payments.description: Indicates whether the business expects to make international payments.

payment_volumes.description: Expected payment volumes. Only required for a root entity.

registration_id.description: Registration ID. At least one form of business identification (`ein` or `registration_id`) is required unless `ein_pending` is set to `true`.

source_of_funds.description: Primary source of funds for the business.

state_of_incorporation.description: State in which the business is incorporated. Only postal abbreviations (e.g. `AL`, `CA`, `DE`, ...) are allowed. Only required for a root entity.

website.description: Website of the business. Optional, but highly encouraged as it will increase likelihood of an automated verification.

year_of_incorporation.description: Year in which the business entity was incorporated. Only required for a root entity.

bank_account_id.description:
Bank account to associate with the card account. This field is only accepted for debit
programs. It must be omitted for credit-backed programs. For `cardholder_secured`
programs, the collateral account is derived from the secured loan and cannot be overridden.

card_authorization_policy_id.description: Card authorization policy to associate with the card account

card_program_id.description: The ID of the card program to create the card account under

loan_id.description:
Loan to associate with the card account. For a `cardholder_secured` program, the loan
must have `type=secured`.

effective_on.description: When the policy becomes effective, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Offsets are converted to UTC and fractional seconds are dropped.

scope.description: The scope of this authorization policy (program, account, or card).

card_authorization_policy_id.description: The ID of the parent card authorization policy

effective_on.description: When the policy version becomes effective, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Offsets are converted to UTC and fractional seconds are dropped.

scope.description: The scope of this authorization policy (program, account, or card). Must match the scope of the policy's existing versions.

amount.description: The dispute amount in smallest currency unit.

card_transaction_id.description: The ID of the card transaction to dispute.

evidence.description: Uploaded document evidence with normalized evidence types. An uploaded document is required for `counterfeit_merchandise`, `incorrect_amount` and `credit_not_processed` disputes, and for `duplicate_processing` and `paid_by_other_means` disputes whose payment proof is a document. A `cardholder_letter` document is required once the card already has two submitted disputes of the same reason against the same merchant within 30 days, for `merchandise_services_not_received` and `non_receipt_cash_at_atm`.

evidence_document_ids.description: Legacy document IDs to use as evidence, uploaded via `POST /issuing/card-disputes/documents`. Documents uploaded via `POST /documents` are rejected.

issue_provisional_credit.description:
Whether to issue a provisional credit for the dispute. Credit will be applied from the card program's
operating account. Not supported for `original_credit_not_accepted` disputes, which return funds the
cardholder received. While the dispute is a draft, the credit can also be issued or removed later via
`/issuing/card-disputes/{card_dispute_id}/provisional-credit`.

reason_details.description: Normalized reason-specific details for the dispute.

reason_for_partial_dispute.description: Reason the cardholder is disputing less than the full transaction amount. Required at submission when `amount` is less than the transaction amount, except for `incorrect_amount` disputes, which are partial by nature: for those the value is stored but never required or sent to the network.

submit.description: Whether to queue the dispute for network submission immediately.

authorized_user_entity_id.description: The ID of the person entity authorized to use this card

card_account_id.description: The ID of the card account to create the card under

card_authorization_policy_id.description: Optional card authorization policy ID for the card

card_template_id.description: Optional card template ID to use for the card. The template must belong to the card account's card program

description.description: Optional description for the card

encrypted_pin.description: Debit card programs only. Base64-encoded encrypted PIN. Omit to create the card without a PIN; the card's `pin_status` is `unset`, and transactions that require a PIN decline with `pin_not_set` until you set one with `PATCH /issuing/cards/{card_id}/pin`. To have Column choose the PIN instead, omit this and pass `generate_pin`. Treat an encrypted PIN like the PIN itself: never log, store, or reuse it.

generate_pin.description: Debit card programs with PIN reveal enabled only. Pass `true` to have Column set a random 4-digit PIN on the card instead of providing `encrypted_pin`, which must then be omitted. The card's `pin_status` is `set`. The PIN is never returned in the response; the cardholder learns it through PIN reveal.

shipping_details.description: Shipping address and contact information for physical card delivery. Required when type is physical

status.description: Optional initial status for the card

type.description: The form factor of the card. Possible values: `virtual`, `physical`.

return_reason.description: Return reason for a manual return. Only `A`, `N`, and `Q` are allowed as manual return reasons.

account_number.description: The account number for the bank account.

account_type.description: The type of the account number. Can be `checking`, `savings`, `general_ledger`, or `loan`.

address.description: Addresses need to adhere to character validation, as addresses are used across multiple payment rails. Characters are validated according to the Fedwire character validation.

description.description: Description of the counterparty visible only in your platform. Maximum length: `127` characters.

email.description: The email address of the beneficiary.

legal_id.description: The legal ID (e.g., Tax ID, Cedula Juridica, etc.) of the beneficiary. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: `127` characters.

legal_type.description: The legal entity type of the beneficiary. Can be `business`, `non_profit`, `individual`, or `sole_proprietor`. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries.

local_account_number.description: The local account number (e.g. Cuenta Cliente in Costa Rica) in the beneficiary's bank. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: 63 characters.

local_bank_code.description: The local bank code of the beneficiary's bank (e.g., India IFSC, Australia BSB, China CNAPS, etc.). This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: `63` characters.

local_bank_country_code.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the beneficiary's local bank.

local_bank_name.description: Name of the beneficiary's local bank.

name.description: The counterparty name who owns the bank account. There is a `127` character limit for this field. For domestic wires, only the first 35 characters are included in the wire message.

phone.description: The phone number of the beneficiary. This field is recommended for international wire transfers, and required in some countries. Maximum length: `31` characters.

routing_number.description: The routing number of the bank.

routing_number_type.description: The type of the routing number. Can be `aba`, `bic`, or `other`.

wire_drawdown_allowed.description: Whitelists counterparties for automatic approval of drawdown requests to Column via Fedwire. If `false`, all inbound drawdown requests from this counterparty will require explicit approval.

account_number_id.description: ID of the account number to which funds will be disbursed. Either `bank_account_id` or `account_number_id` must be specified. For offline disbursements, this is for record only and no funds will be disbursed.

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of the funds that will be disbursed.

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account to which funds will be disbursed. Either `bank_account_id` or `account_number_id` must be specified. For offline disbursements, this is for record only and no funds will be disbursed.

currency.description: The currency of the disbursement. Currently only `USD` is supported.

description.description: The description of the loan disbursement. Maximum length: `127` characters.

hold.description: If set to `true`, creates a disbursement in a `hold` state. The disbursement will not be completed until the `clear` API is called. Disbursements in a `hold` state may be updated or canceled.

is_offline.description: If set to `true`, the disbursement will only increase the principal receivables sold to your platform. The retained principal receivables will not be impacted and no funds will be credited to the bank account. [Read more]({{lending.disbursement}}).

loan_id.description: The ID of the loan from which the disbursement is being made.

data.description: Structured data associated with the evidence, as a JSON object. The shape of this object depends on the evidence type.

description.description: A description of the evidence. Maximum 255 characters.

evidence_type.description: The type of evidence to submit.

omit_data_in_response.description: When true, the `data` field of each evidence object in the response is returned as an empty object. The submitted data is still stored in full. Use this to keep responses small when submitting large payloads for multiple purposes, since each created evidence object otherwise echoes the full data.

purposes.description: The purposes of the evidence submission. Column creates one evidence record per purpose, all referencing the same document/data. Use `cardholder_agreement` for cardholder agreements collected for card programs.

evidence.description: The created evidence records, one per requested purpose.

body.description: The free-form text of the narrative. Maximum length is 30,000 characters. Narratives are append-only and cannot be edited after creation.

related_document_id.description: Optional ID of a document this narrative references. The document must belong to your platform.

related_field.description: Optional entity field path this narrative is about, e.g. `last_name` or `associated_persons.control_person.address`.

allow_overdraft.description: Whether overdraft is allowed for this transfer

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of the currency. e.g., 1756 means 1.756 in `KWD`, 17.56 in `USD`, or 1756 in `JPY`.

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account sending the transfer. Exactly one of `bank_account_id` or `account_number_id` must be provided.

charge_bearer.description: The charge bearer code. Can be `DEBT`, `CRED`, or `SHAR`.

counterparty_id.description: ID of the counterparty receiving the transfer

currency_code.description: Currency code (ISO 4217). e.g. `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`.

description.description: A description of the transfer

fx_quote_id.description: The ID of an FX quote to use for this transfer

intermediary_bank.description: SWIFT BIC of the intermediary bank

ultimate_originator_counterparty.description: Inline ultimate originator counterparty details. See counterparty creation for full field reference.

CreateLoanInterestConfigRequest.description: Configuration for interest accrual on a loan.

accrual_method.description: The accrual method for interest calculation. Possible values: `actual_360`, `actual_365`, and `actual_actual`.

description.description: A description for the interest configuration

history.description: List of interest config snapshots defining rates and their effective dates. At least one snapshot is required.

account_number_id.description: ID of the source account number. Source account is required if this payment is not offline, or the loan is not completely owned by your platform. Either `bank_account_id` or `account_number_id` must be specified.

amount.description: Amount in cents for principal and interest payments. At least one of `amount` or `principal_amount` must be specified.

bank_account_id.description: ID of the source bank account. Source account is required if this payment is not offline, or the loan is not completely owned by your platform. Either `bank_account_id` or `account_number_id` must be specified.

currency.description: The currency of the payment. Currently only `USD` is supported.

description.description: The description of the loan payment. Maximum: `127` characters.

ignore_retained_balances.description: Indicates whether this payment should be applied to sold balances only. [Read more]({{lending.payment}}).

is_offline.description: Indicates if this payment is an offline payment. Default value: `false`.

loan_id.description: The ID of the loan to which the payment is being made. The `principal_outstanding` of the loan will decrease by the payment amount.

principal_amount.description: Amount in cents for principal payments. At least one of `amount` or `principal_amount` must be specified.

allow_overpayment.description: Indicates if a loan is able to be overpaid and have a `principal_outstanding` of less than $0. If `false`, payments that would result in a loan having a negative balance will be blocked.

auto_sell.description: Indicates if seasoned principals/interests should be automatically sold to your platform. Default: the value in the loan program.

collateral_bank_account_id.description: The bank account that collateralizes a secured loan.

currency.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217, e.g. `USD`.

description.description: The description of the loan in the Column dashboard.

entity_id.description: The entity to create the loan under.

interest_config.description: Inline interest configuration to create with the loan. Either `interest_config_id` or `interest_config` may be specified, but not both.

interest_config_id.description: ID of the interest configuration used to accrue interest receivable daily. If this field is not set, the default interest configuration of the loan program will be used. The same interest configuration can be shared across multiple loans. Either `interest_config_id` or `interest_config` may be specified, but not both.

is_business_seasoning_days.description: Indicates if `seasoning_days` are business days or calendar days. Default: the value in the loan program.

is_revolving.description: Indicates whether or not the loan is revolving. If `true` the loan can have multiple disbursements. Default: the value in the loan program.

loan_program_id.description: ID of the loan program for this loan. If this field is not set, your platform's default loan program will be used.

maturity_date.description: The maturity date of the loan. It is required if the loan is not revolving.

max_principal_balance.description: The max principal balance of the loan in cents. This is akin to a credit limit. Disbursements will fail if the resulting principal will be above the max principal. e.g. $1.75 would be represented by `175`.

retained_by_column.description: Indicates if this loan should be retained by Column. Loans retained by Column are not eligible for your platform to purchase. Default: the value in the loan program.

type.description: The loan type. Possible values are `unsecured` and `secured`.

LoanDisbursement.description: A loan disbursement object represents the moment when loan funds are released. It is associated to one loan object and occurs after the loan has been approved. The funds can be sent directly to the borrower or to a third-party loan servicer. Each loan can have one or multiple loan disbursements.

account_number_id.description: The unique ID of the account to which the funds are disbursed

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of funds disbursed to the borrower

bank_account_id.description: The bank account to which funds are disbursed

created_at.description: The timestamp the loan disbursement was created

currency.description: The currency of the loan. Currently only `USD` is supported.

description.description: The description of the loan disbursement in the Column dashboard

effective_at.description: The timestamp the loan disbursement was marked effective

id.description: The unique ID of the loan disbursement object

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key specified in the loan disbursement. Returns an empty string `""` when not set.

is_offline.description: Indicates if the loan disbursement is an offline disbursement. [Read more]({{lending.disbursement}}).

loan_id.description: The unique ID of the loan object the loan disbursement is associated to

status.description: The current status of the loan disbursement. Possible values: `completed`, `canceled`, `hold`, `manual_review`, `rejected`.

LoanInterestConfigSnapshot.description: A snapshot defining interest rates for a specific effective date or period.

effective_after_days.description: The number of days after which this config snapshot becomes effective. Either `effective_date` or `effective_after_days` may be specified, but not both.

effective_date.description: The date in Pacific Time Zone (inclusive) on which this interest config snapshot becomes effective. Either `effective_date` or `effective_after_days` may be specified, but not both.

effective_day_mode.description: The method for rolling the effective date derived from `effective_after_days` to the next business day if it falls on a weekend or holiday. Possible values: `business_day`, `next_business_day`.

fixed_rate.description: The fixed interest rate for this snapshot (4.50% would be represented as `0.045`).

pivot_percentage.description: The percentage of the pivot rate to use for variable-rate interest calculation (e.g., `1.0` for 100% of the pivot rate).

pivot_relative.description: The spread added to or subtracted from the pivot rate for variable-rate interest calculation (e.g., `0.02` for +2%).

LoanPayment.description: A loan payment object represents a repayment made toward a loan. It is associated with one loan object and typically occurs after one or more loan disbursements have been made. Payments can be made by the borrower directly or through a loan servicer. [Read more]({{lending.payment}}).

account_number_id.description: The unique ID of the account to which the payment was made

amount.description: Total payment amount in cents

bank_account_id.description: The bank account to which funds are paid back to

collection_account_number_id.description: ID of your collections account number

created_at.description: The timestamp the loan payment was created

currency.description: The currency of the loan. Currently only `USD` is supported.

description.description: The description of the loan payment in the Column dashboard

effective_at.description: The timestamp the loan payment was marked effective

id.description: The ID of the loan payment object

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key specified in the loan payment. Returns an empty string `""` when not set.

ignore_retained_balances.description: Indicates whether the loan payment was applied to sold balances only. [Read more]({{lending.payment}}).

is_offline.description: Indicates whether the loan payment was made offline

loan_id.description: The ID of the loan object the loan payment is associated to

principal_amount.description: Amount of the payment applied to the loan principal

retained_interest_amount.description: Paid interest receivable owned by Column

retained_principal_amount.description: Paid principal amount owned by Column

status.description: The current status of the loan payment. Possible values: `completed`, or `returned`.

LoanProgram.description: Loan Program objects represent the configuration for loan programs in your platform. They define settings for loan purchases, auto-selling, and account configurations. You cannot create new loan programs on your own. Please work with your Column team / Solution Engineer to create loan programs for your platform based on your Column use cases. [Read more]({{lending}}).

auto_sell.description: Indicates if seasoned principals/interests should be automatically sold to your platform

auto_sell_business_day_only.description: Whether auto-sell only occurs on business days

close_after_sale.description: Indicates if loans that are not revolving should be closed after automatic sale. [Read more]({{lending.sale}}).

collection_account_number_id.description: Default account number ID of your platform to deposit loan payments belonging to your platform in this loan program

created_at.description: The timestamp when the loan program was created

default_interest_config_id.description: ID of the default interest configuration for this loan program

description.description: The description of the loan program

id.description: The ID of the loan program

is_business_seasoning_days.description: Indicates if the default `seasoning_days` are business days or calendar days

is_revolving.description: Indicates if loans in this loan program are revolving

max_days_to_purchase.description: Maximum number of calendar days for seasoned principals/interests to be purchased by your platform

purchase_funding_account_number_id.description: Default account number ID for your platform to fund loan purchases in this loan program

retained_by_column.description: Indicates if loans in this loan program are retained by Column

seasoning_days.description: Default number of seasoning days for loans in this loan program

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the loan program was last updated

LoanSale.description: A loan sale object represents the sale of a loan by Column to your platform. When a loan is sold, you purchase the principal and interest receivables from Column, and are paid a servicing fee. [Read more]({{lending.sale}}).

amount.description: The total sale amount in cents

created_at.description: The timestamp at which the loan sale was created

currency_code.description: The currency code of the sale amount. Currently only `USD` is supported.

description.description: The description of the loan sale

id.description: The ID of the loan sale object

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key specified in the loan sale

loan_id.description: The ID of the loan being sold

paid_servicing_fee.description: The amount of servicing fees in cents paid to your platform by Column

purchase_funding_account_number_id.description: The ID of the account number in your platform that was funded to complete this sale

sold_at.description: The timestamp at which the loan sale was completed

sold_interest_receivable.description: The amount of interest receivable in cents sold to your platform

sold_principal_receivable.description: The amount of principal receivable in cents sold to your platform

updated_at.description: The timestamp at which the loan sale was last updated

LoanSaleSummary.description: Loan sale summaries are aggregated from our `loan_daily_summary` reports. [Read more]({{lending.report}}).

currency_code.description: Currency of the loan

effective_date.description: Effective date of loan sales. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`

loans.description: List of loans with loan details for sale

total_interest.description: Total interest amount in cents of loans for sale

LoanSummary.description: Loan Summary objects represent daily snapshots of loan performance and financial data. [Read more]({{lending.report}}).

daily_sold_principal.description: The principal amount sold on this date, in cents

sale_price.description: The sale price of the loan, in cents

total_retained_principal.description: The total principal amount retained by Column, in cents

total_seasoned_principal.description: The total principal amount that has met seasoning requirements, in cents

fee.description: Fee in cents of the loan for sale

interest.description: Interest in cents of the loan for sale

principal.description: Principal in cents of the loan for sale

sale_price.description: Sale price in cents of the loan

Lockbox.description: A lockbox that receives mail and checks for an account.

account_number_id.description: ID of the account number linked to the lockbox

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account linked to the lockbox

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the lockbox was created

description.description: Optional description of the lockbox

id.description: Unique ID for the lockbox

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key used to create the lockbox, if provided.

processing_center.description: Processing center assigned to the lockbox.

status.description:
The current status of the lockbox. Possible values:
- `active`: Lockbox is ready to accept checks.
- `closed`: Lockbox is deleted, and no more checks will be accepted.
- `pending`: Lockbox is still under review, and not ready to accept checks yet.

type.description: Type of lockbox address.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the lockbox was last updated

attachment_document_id.description: ID of a document to include as an attachment with the mailed check.

courtesy_of.description: Name of the person or organization sending the check on behalf of the payor.

delivery_method.description: Delivery method for the check. Can be one of `usps_first_class`, `fedex_two_day`, or `fedex_overnight`. Defaults to `usps_first_class`.

memo.description: Memo line text to print on the check.

payee_address.description: The mailing address of the payee where the check will be sent. `line_1` and `line_2` are each limited to 35 characters, and their combined length must not exceed 50 characters.

payee_company.description: Company name of the payee, if applicable.

payor_address.description: The return address of the payor to print on the check envelope. When provided, `line_1` and `line_2` are each limited to 35 characters, and their combined length must not exceed 50 characters.

payor_name.description: Name of the payor to print on the check.

signatory.description: Name of the signatory to print on the check.

ManufacturingDetails.description: The manufacturing details object tracks physical cards through manufacturing and shipping. This object is `null` for virtual cards.

manufacturing_status.description: The current status of the card in the manufacturing and fulfillment process. Possible values: `pending_order`

shipping_details.description: Shipping address and contact information provided when the card was created

account_number.description: Latest account number of the counterparty

account_type.description: Account type derived from the corrected ACH transaction code, when supported

change_code.description: NACHA code identifying the information corrected by the Notification of Change

receiver_id.description: Latest accounting reference number by which the beneficiary should be referred by the originator

routing_number.description: Latest routing number of the counterparty

transaction_code.description: Corrected ACH transaction code, when supplied by the Notification of Change

currency_code.description: Amount currency. The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217 (e.g. `USD`).

address.description: Addresses need to adhere to character validation, as addresses are used across multiple payment rails. Characters are validated according to the Fedwire character validation.

country_of_citizenship.description: Country of citizenship of the individual. Country of citizenship does not need to match the issuing country of an identity document. ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 Country Code (e.g., `US`, `FR`, `UK`, `DE`, ...).

drivers_license.description: Driver's License Details. Passport, Driver's License or National ID is required for non U.S. citizens. When left blank, the Passport field returns an empty object ( ) and the Driver's License and National ID fields return `null`.

email.description: Email of the individual. Optional, but highly encouraged as it will increase likelihood of an automated verification. When left blank, the Email field returns an empty string (`""`).

expected_payment_rails.description: Expected transaction types for the account. Comma-separated list of payment rails; each value must be one of: `ach`, `wire`, `swift`, `check`, `rtp`, `card_spend`.

first_name.description: First name of the legal person. Must adhere to Fedwire character validation.

income.description: Estimated pre-tax annual income. Accepts an array to allow passing income ranges.

is_beneficial_owner.description: Boolean value which specifies if this person is a designated beneficial owner.

is_control_person.description: Boolean value which specifies if this person is a designated control person.

is_high_risk.description: Indicates whether the entity has been identified as high risk based on compliance screening

job_title.description: Job title of the beneficial owner or control person.

last_name.description: Last name of the legal person. Must adhere to Fedwire character validation.

makes_international_payments.description: Indicates whether the individual expects to make international payments.

middle_name.description: Middle name of the legal person. Must adhere to Fedwire character validation.

national_id.description: National ID Details. Passport, Driver's License or National ID is required for non U.S. citizens. When left blank, the Passport field returns an empty object ( ) and the Driver's License and National ID fields return `null`.

occupation.description: Industry of employment or occupation of the individual.

ownership_percentage.description: Percentage ownership, specified as an integer, of the beneficial owner

passport.description: Passport Details. Passport, Driver's License or National ID is required for non U.S. citizens. When left blank, the Passport field returns an empty object ( ) and the Driver's License and National ID fields return `null`.

pep_status.description: Politically Exposed Person screening status. Allowed values: `not_checked`, `no`, `yes`, `potential`.

phone_number.description: Phone number of the individual in the E.164 format. Optional, but highly encouraged as it will increase likelihood of an automated verification. When left blank, the phone number field returns an empty string (`""`).

role.description: Individual's role or job title at their place of employment.

source_of_income.description: Sources of income for the individual.

ssn.description: Social Security Number. SSN is required for U.S. citizens. ITIN may be shared in place of SSN. If SSN is provided, country of citizenship is not required. When left blank (i.e., for non-U.S. citizens) the SSN field returns an empty string (`""`).

book_directly.description: If `true`, the quote will be booked immediately upon creation.

buy_amount.description: Amount to buy in the smallest unit of the buy currency.

buy_currency_code.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the currency to buy.

fx_fee_bps.description: Foreign exchange fee in basis points.

rate_date.description: The calendar date to use for the exchange rate. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. If not provided, today's rate is used.

RealtimeRFP.description: The Realtime Request For Payment (RFP) object represents the current state of a single Realtime RFP initiated by or received by Column. Realtime RFPs are used to initiate and receive debit requests called Request for Payments over FedNow or the RTP network. The Realtime RFP object exposes all relevant information about the Realtime RFP to developers.

accepted_at.description: The timestamp when the Realtime RFP was accepted

account_number_id.description: ID of the account number that is sending/receiving the RFP

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of the funds that will be transferred between originator and counterparty accounts. e.g. $1.75 would be represented by 175

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account that is sending/receiving the RFP

canceled_at.description: The timestamp at which the Realtime RFP was canceled

completed_at.description: The timestamp at which the Realtime RFP was completed

counterparty_id.description: ID of the counterparty that is receiving/sending the RFP

currency_code.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217. e.g. `USD`

description.description: A description of the RFP visible in account statements

end_to_end_id.description: A unique identifier for the transfer that is passed through to the receiving bank. This is used for reconciliation purposes between originator and receiver.

is_on_us.description: Indicates the Realtime RFP is between two bank accounts held at Column

realtime_transfer_id.description: Realtime transfer object of a credit transfer that was sent/received to settle an accepted RFP

rejected_at.description: The timestamp at which the Realtime transfer was rejected after acceptance without posting

rejection_additional_info.description: Contains further information on the rejection reason in free-formatted text, if available

rejection_code.description: Code representing a reason for Realtime payment rejection

status.description: The current status of the Realtime transfer. Possible statuses are `initiated`, `presented`, `received`, `accepted`, `completed`, `rejected`, `expired`, `canceled`.

has_more.description: Whether more RFPs are available

realtime_rfps.description: List of realtime requests for payment

RealtimeReturnRequest.description: The Realtime Return Request represents a request to return funds from a previously completed Realtime transfer.

accepted_at.description: The timestamp at which the Return Request was accepted

id.description: The unique id of the Return Request object

is_incoming.description: Indicates whether the Return Request is incoming (`true`) or outgoing (`false`)

original_transfer_id.description: ID of the original Realtime transfer for which the return of funds is being requested

pending_at.description: The timestamp at which the Return Request was created and status was set to pending

reason_code.description: Code representing a reason for the Return Request. Reason code types include: AC03, AM09, CUST, DUPL, FRAD, TECH, and UPAY

Reason code descriptions include: AC03 - Account number is invalid or has been closed, AM09 - Amount is not the amount agreed or expected, CUST - Cancellation requested by the Debtor, DUPL - Payment is a duplicate of another payment, FRAD - Cancellation requested following a transaction that was originated fraudulently, TECH - Cancellation requested following technical problems resulting in an erroneous transaction, UPAY - Payment is not justified (missing critical information)

rejected_at.description: The timestamp at which the Return Request was rejected

return_transfer_id.description: ID of the Realtime transfer created when the Return Request is accepted, representing the return of funds

Realtime transfers are used to send and receive money over FedNow or RTP. The Realtime transfer object exposes all relevant information about the Realtime transfer to developers.

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of the funds that will be transferred between originator and counterparty accounts. e.g. $1.75 would be represented by 175

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account that is sending/receiving the transfer

blocked_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was blocked after accepting without posting

canceled_at.description: The timestamp when a held realtime transfer was canceled and the funds returned to the available balance

completed_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was completed

counterparty_id.description: ID of the counterparty that is receiving/sending the transfer

created_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was created

created_by.description: The identity (API key or dashboard user) that created the realtime transfer.

currency_code.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217. e.g. `USD`

description.description: A description of the transfer visible in account statements

end_to_end_id.description: A unique identifier for the transfer that is passed through to the receiving bank. This is used for reconciliation purposes between originator and receiver. This ID may not be populated on an incoming Realtime transfer.

hold_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer entered the hold state

id.description: The unique ID of the object

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key specified in the realtime transfer

initiated_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was initiated

is_incoming.description: Indicates whether the realtime transfer was incoming ( `true` or outgoing `false` ).

is_on_us.description: Indicates whether the realtime transfer was between two bank accounts held at Column

manual_review_approved_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was approved after manual review

manual_review_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer went into the manual review state

manual_review_rejected_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was rejected after manual review

pending_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was accepted without posting and is pending

pre_review_at.description: The timestamp when transfer approval became required for the realtime transfer

realtime_rfp_id.description: The linked realtime request for payment ID

rejected_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was rejected after acceptance without posting

rejection_additional_info.description: Contains further information on the payment status reason in free-formatted text, if available

rejection_code.description: Code representing a reason for rejecting realtime payment

return_pair_transfer_id.description: Provides a reference to a pair return transfer created when return was accepted. It is either the original transfer or the return transfer ID.

reviews.description: The transfer approval decisions recorded on the realtime transfer. Each entry is a dashboard user approving or rejecting the transfer while it was in `pre_review`. This list is only populated when transfer approvals are enabled for the platform, or for the API key that created the transfer; otherwise it is omitted from the response.

status.description: The current status of the realtime transfer. Possible statuses are `pre_review`, `hold`, `canceled`, `initiated`, `pending`, `accepted`, `completed`, `blocked`, `rejected`, `manual_review`, `manual_review_approved`, `manual_review_rejected`.

ultimate_debtor_counterparty_id.description: ID of the ultimate debtor counterparty that was set on the transfer

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the realtime transfer was updated

has_more.description: Whether more transfers are available

rejection_reason.description: Reason for rejecting the return request

additional_info.description: Additional information about the rejection. Maximum 105 characters.

reject_reason.description: The reason for rejecting the return request. Possible values: `beneficiary_account_closed`, `non_sufficient_funds`, `funds_already_returned`, `rejected_by_beneficiary`, `legal_decision`, `no_response_from_beneficiary`.

encrypted_pin.description: Debit card programs only. Omit to keep the original card's PIN on the renewed card. A carried-over PIN starts unblocked, with no wrong attempts counted, even if the original card's PIN was blocked. Pass a base64-encoded encrypted PIN to set a new PIN, or `SKIP` to create the renewed card without a PIN (`pin_status` is `unset`) and set one later with `PATCH /issuing/cards/{card_id}/pin`. To have Column choose a new PIN instead, omit this and pass `generate_pin`. Treat an encrypted PIN like the PIN itself: never log, store, or reuse it.

expiration_year.description: Optional new expiration year (4-digit year, e.g. 2025)

generate_pin.description: Debit card programs with PIN reveal enabled only. Pass `true` to have Column set a new random 4-digit PIN on the renewed card instead of keeping the original card's PIN or providing `encrypted_pin`, which must then be omitted. The PIN is never returned in the response; the cardholder learns it through PIN reveal.

status.description: Optional status for the renewed card

deactivation_reason.description: Reason for deactivating the original card during replacement. `lost`, `stolen`, `fraud`, and `voluntary` requests create a replacement with a new PAN. `damaged` requests reuse the PAN. `expired` requests are processed as renewal-style replacements with the same PAN and a new expiration, and the original card's reason is recorded as `renewed`. All non-terminal card tokens on the original card are deactivated for every reason. `renewed` and `account_closed` are not accepted by this endpoint.

encrypted_pin.description: Debit card programs only. Base64-encoded encrypted PIN for the replacement card. `expired` and `damaged` replacements reuse the PAN, so omitting this keeps the original card's PIN; pass `SKIP` to create the replacement without a PIN instead. A carried-over PIN starts unblocked, with no wrong attempts counted, even if the original card's PIN was blocked. `lost`, `stolen`, `fraud`, and `voluntary` replacements get a new PAN, which the original PIN can't carry over to, so omitting this creates the replacement without a PIN. A card without a PIN has `pin_status` set to `unset`, and transactions that require a PIN decline with `pin_not_set` until you set one with `PATCH /issuing/cards/{card_id}/pin`. To have Column choose a new PIN instead, omit this and pass `generate_pin`. Treat an encrypted PIN like the PIN itself: never log, store, or reuse it.

generate_pin.description: Debit card programs with PIN reveal enabled only. Pass `true` to have Column set a new random 4-digit PIN on the replacement card instead of keeping the original card's PIN or providing `encrypted_pin`, which must then be omitted. The PIN is never returned in the response; the cardholder learns it through PIN reveal.

status.description: Optional status for the replacement card

action.description: The response action to take for the current dispute stage.

amount.description: Partial acceptance amount in smallest currency unit. Required for accept_partial.

cardholder_name_and_address_mismatch.description: Certifies that the cardholder name and address the acquirer presented as compelling evidence do not match your records. Required when declining or partially accepting a fraud pre-arbitration in which the acquirer presented compelling evidence, and rejected for any other response. When `false`, `narrative` is sent to Visa as the explanation of why you are continuing the dispute.

compelling_evidence_reviewed_with_cardho.description: Certifies that you contacted the cardholder, reviewed the acquirer's compelling evidence with them, and the cardholder continues to dispute the transaction. Required when declining or partially accepting a fraud pre-arbitration in which the acquirer presented compelling evidence, and rejected for any other response. When `true`, `narrative` is sent to Visa as the explanation of why the cardholder continues to dispute.

evidence.description: Uploaded document evidence with normalized evidence types.

evidence_document_ids.description: Legacy document IDs to use as evidence, uploaded via `POST /issuing/card-disputes/documents`. Documents uploaded via `POST /documents` are rejected.

narrative.example: The merchant's response does not show that the cardholder authorized the transaction.

message_to_originator_bank.description: Message to include with the return

return_reason.description: The reason for returning the transfer. Possible values: `incorrect_beneficiary_account`, `beneficiary_account_blocked`, `incorrect_amount`, `beneficiary_mismatch`, `refused_by_beneficiary`, `cancellation_requested`, `fraud`, `compliance_rejected`, `missing_originator_data`.

description.description: Description for the reversal.

reason.description: The reason for reversing the ACH transfer.

allow_overdraft.description: Allow the account to go negative for the reversal.

description.description: Description for the wire reversal. Maximum length: `255` characters.

reason.description: The reason for reversing the wire transfer.

SendPasscodeOTPFields.description: The step-up passcode fields carried on the send-passcode webhook alongside the card token.

otp_email.description:
The email address to deliver the passcode to. Present only when `otp_method_type` is
`email`; otherwise omitted.

otp_method_type.description:
The resolved delivery method for the passcode (`sms` or `email`). Empty when Column cannot
resolve the delivery method.

otp_phone_number.description:
The phone number (E.164) to deliver the passcode to. Present only when `otp_method_type`
is `sms`; otherwise omitted.

otp_value.description: The one-time passcode to deliver to the cardholder.

SendPasscodeWebhookPayload.description:
Payload for the `issuing.card_token.send_passcode` and `issuing.card_token.device_binding.send_passcode`
webhooks. Column emits this when Visa requests OTP delivery to the cardholder during step-up
authentication so the platform can deliver the one-time passcode. It carries the full card token
(its fields hoisted to the top level, matching other `issuing.card_token.*` events) alongside the

cardholder_amount.description:
Transaction amount in the merchant's currency, expressed in the smallest currency unit.
For example, 1000 represents 10.00 `EUR`. When `merchant_currency` is not `USD`,
this amount is multiplied by `cardholder_fx_rate` to derive the `USD` billing amount.
Must not exceed 999999999999.

cardholder_fx_rate.description:
Foreign exchange rate to convert from merchant currency to `USD` (cardholder billing currency),
as a decimal string. Required when `merchant_currency` is not `USD`.
For example, if `merchant_currency` is `EUR` and `cardholder_fx_rate` is `"1.10"`,
a 10.00 `EUR` transaction will result in an 11.00 `USD` cardholder charge.

entry_mode.description:
How the card is presented to the merchant, which sets the simulated message's PAN entry mode (Field 22) and
POS condition code (Field 25). Use it to test card-present and card-not-present decisioning. Defaults to
`swipe` for physical cards and `ecommerce` for virtual cards.

- `swipe`: the physical card's magnetic stripe is read at an attended terminal. The message carries the
  card's track data, which Column verifies.
- `keyed`: the physical card's number is typed into the terminal by hand. The message carries no track
  data, and carries the card's CVV2.
- `ecommerce`: the card is used at an online checkout. The message carries no track data, and carries the
  card's CVV2.

Virtual cards only support `ecommerce`, and `cardholder_input.pin` is not supported with `ecommerce`.
Chip and contactless entry are not supported, because they need an EMV cryptogram the simulator cannot
generate under sandbox card keys.

merchant_category_code.description:
Optional merchant category code (ISO 18245 MCC) to put on the simulated message (Field 18), for
example `5812` (restaurants) or `6011` (ATM). Defaults to `5999`. Use it to exercise real-time
decisioning rules that depend on the merchant category.

merchant_city.description:
Optional card acceptor city to put on the simulated message (Field 43, positions 26-38).
Defaults to `CITY NAME`. At most 13 characters.

merchant_country_code.description:
Optional card acceptor country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, to put on the simulated message (Field 43,
positions 39-40). Defaults to `US`. Use it to exercise country-based decisioning rules.

merchant_currency.description: Merchant's currency code in ISO 4217 format.

merchant_name.description:
Optional card acceptor name to put on the simulated message (Field 43, positions 1-25).
Defaults to `ACQUIRER NAME`. At most 25 characters.

network_decision_reason.description:
The reason for the network's decline decision. Only applicable when
`network_standin` is `declined`. Determines the network response code
on the transaction. Defaults to `generic_decline` if not specified.

network_standin.description:
Simulates a scenario where the card network makes the authorization decision
on behalf of the issuer (e.g., due to issuer timeout). When set, the resulting
transaction will have `decision_source` set to `card_network`.

- `approved` — the network approves the transaction.
- `declined` — the network declines the transaction.

realtime_decision.description:
Specifies the issuer's real-time authorization decision to inject if the transaction
reaches the real-time decisioning step. Mutually exclusive with `network_standin`.

- `approve` — the issuer approves the transaction.
- `decline` — the issuer declines the transaction (see `realtime_decision_reason`).
- `partially_approve` — the issuer partially approves the transaction
  (requires `realtime_partially_approved_amount`).

When neither `realtime_decision` nor `network_standin` is provided, the simulator
attempts a real real-time authorization decision webhook to the platform's configured
`decision.issuing.card_transaction` destination (declining if no destination is configured).

realtime_decision_reason.description:
The reason for the issuer's real-time decline decision. Only applicable when
`realtime_decision` is `decline`. Defaults to `generic_decline` if not specified.

realtime_funding_account_id.description:
The bank account to just-in-time fund the authorization from, as a platform's real-time authorization
decision would name in `funding_account_id`. Only applicable when `realtime_decision` is `approve` or
`partially_approve`, and only on debit card programs with `jit_funding_enabled`.

realtime_partially_approved_amount.description:
The amount to partially approve, in the smallest unit of the cardholder billing currency (`USD`).
Required when `realtime_decision` is `partially_approve`, and must be less than the amount
billed to the cardholder: `cardholder_amount` when `merchant_currency` is `USD`, or
`cardholder_amount` converted at `cardholder_fx_rate` otherwise.

three_ds_attempt_id.description:
Optional 3DS attempt ID to link to this authorization. The 3DS attempt must be in
`authenticated` status and belong to the same card. When provided, the authorization
will include authentication details with liability shift.

SimulateCardholderBillingAddress.description:
The billing address the cardholder enters, for example at checkout or at a fuel pump. The simulator sends it in
the Visa address verification (AVS) fields, and Column's real AVS check compares each field with the
cardholder entity's address. The results appear in the card transaction's `cardholder_verification_details`
as `street_address_verification_status` and `postal_code_verification_status`: `verified` when the field
matches, `invalid` when it doesn't, and `not_provided` when it is omitted. AVS is informational: a mismatch
does not decline the authorization, and the merchant decides what to do with the result.

postal_code.description:
The postal code, as 1 to 9 letters, digits, spaces or hyphens. Send a US ZIP+4 as 9 digits without the
hyphen, for example `941051234`. A 5-digit ZIP matches a ZIP+4 on file with the same first 5 digits.

street.description:
The street address line, as 1 to 40 printable ASCII characters. AVS compares the digits in the address
(the house number, plus any unit number), so `123 Main St` matches an address on file of `123 Main Street`.

SimulateCardholderExpirationDate.description:
The expiration date the cardholder presents, which the simulator sends in the message (Field 14). Column
compares it with the card's `expiration_month` and `expiration_year`.

- The date matches the card's: expiration verification passes and the transaction continues to decisioning.
- The date doesn't match: the transaction is declined with `decision_reason` `invalid_expiration` and
  `decision_source` `column`.

Omit it to send no expiration date, in which case Column skips the check. A card past its own expiration
declines with `card_expired` whatever date is presented.

year.description:
The expiration year, as a 4-digit year from 2000 to 2068. Field 14 carries only the last two digits, which
decode to 2000-2068 (00-68) or 1969-1999 (69-99), so later years can't be presented.

SimulateCardholderInput.description:
What the cardholder enters at the terminal or online checkout. Column's real verification checks each input
against the card, so the outcome is the one a real transaction would get.

cvv2.description:
The CVV2 the cardholder types at an online checkout or a keyed terminal, as 3 or 4 digits. Column verifies it
against the card's CVV2.

- The CVV2 matches: CVV2 verification passes and the transaction continues to decisioning.
- The CVV2 doesn't match: the transaction is declined with `decision_reason` `invalid_cvv2` and
  `decision_source` `column`.

Only supported when the card is keyed or used online: `entry_mode` `keyed` or `ecommerce`, which is a virtual
card's default. A swiped card, a physical card's default, carries no CVV2, so `cvv2` is rejected. When
omitted, a keyed or online transaction carries the card's real CVV2.

pin.description:
The PIN the cardholder types on the terminal's PIN pad, as 4 to 12 digits in plaintext. Sandbox only: the
simulator encrypts it the way a terminal would, and Column verifies it against the card's PIN.

- The PIN matches: PIN verification passes and the transaction continues to decisioning.
- The PIN doesn't match: the transaction is declined with `decision_reason` `pin_invalid` and
  `decision_source` `column`. 3 wrong PINs in a row block the card's PIN.
- The card has no PIN set: declined with `pin_not_set`.
- The card's PIN is blocked: declined with `pin_blocked`, whatever the PIN, until you unblock it with
  `POST /issuing/cards/{card_id}/pin/unblock`.

Not supported for virtual cards, which have no terminal.

Payload for the `issuing.3ds.otp_generated` webhook. Column emits this when the cardholder selects a
