is_incoming.description: Whether this is an incoming return request (created by another bank) or outgoing (initiated by us)

manual_review_at.description: The timestamp when the wire return request went into the manual review state

original_transfer_id.description: ID of the original transfer that this return request is requesting to return

rejected_at.description: The timestamp when the wire return request is rejected

return_request_reason.description: The reason of the return request

return_request_response_reason.description: The reason of the response to the return request

scheduled_at.description: The timestamp when the wire return request is scheduled to be sent

sent_at.description: The timestamp when the wire return request is sent

status.description: The status of the wire return request. Possible statuses include `initiated`, `scheduled`, `sent`, `manual_review`, `approved`, `rejected`, and `completed`.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the wire return request was updated

WireTransfer.description: The wire transfer object represents the current state of a single wire transfer initiated by or received by Column. Wire transfers are used to send and receive money over Fedwire. The wire transfer object exposes all relevant information about the wire transfer to developers.

account_number_id.description: ID of the account number that is sending/receiving the transfer

allow_overdraft.description: Allows the account to go negative for an outgoing transfer. The bank account needs to have `is_overdraftable` enabled with an overdraft reserve account linked to it

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of the funds that will be transferred between originator and counterparty accounts. e.g. $1.75 would be represented by 175.

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account that is sending/receiving the transfer

beneficiary_account_number.description: The external account number to which the wire is being sent

beneficiary_name.description: The name of the person who is receiving the wire

beneficiary_reference.description: Reference information for the beneficiary included in the wire transfer.

business_function_code.description: The business function code specified in the wire transfer. Possible business function codes are `BTR`, `CTP`, `CTR`, `DRC`, or `DRW`.

completed_at.description: The timestamp when the wire was completed

counterparty_id.description: ID of the counterparty that is receiving/sending the transfer

created_at.description: The timestamp when the wire was created

created_by.description: The identity (API key or dashboard user) that created the wire transfer.

creditor_agent_name.description: Name of the creditor's financial institution.

creditor_agent_routing_number.description: Routing number of the creditor's financial institution.

creditor_tax_id.description: A Tax Identification Number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) of exactly `9` numeric characters for the creditor. This field is only required when the counterparty routing number is one of the Treasury tax payment RTNs ('091036164' or '091036177') for an outgoing wire transfer.

currency_code.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217. e.g. `USD`

debtor_agent_name.description: Name of the debtor's financial institution.

debtor_agent_routing_number.description: Routing number of the debtor's financial institution.

description.description: A description of the transfer visible in account statements. This field contains "originator to beneficiary" information and will be transmitted to the RDFI. The description has a `140` character limit.

fi_to_fi_information_line_1.description: Financial institution to financial institution information, most often used by a FI to explain the reason for a wire reversal

fi_to_fi_information_line_2.description: Financial institution to financial institution information line 2.

fi_to_fi_information_line_3.description: Financial institution to financial institution information line 3.

fi_to_fi_information_line_4.description: Financial institution to financial institution information line 4.

fi_to_fi_information_line_5.description: Financial institution to financial institution information line 5.

fi_to_fi_information_line_6.description: Financial institution to financial institution information line 6.

hold_at.description: The timestamp when the wire transfer entered the hold state.

id.description: The unique ID of the object

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key specified in the wire transfer

imad.description: Stands for Input/Output Message Accountability Data. A unique number set by the originating bank given to each Fedwire payment when using the Federal Reserve Bank Service and can be used to investigate and track wire transfers. IMAD will be populated asynchronously and will not be populated on the completed event. IMAD will also not be populated for on-us wire transfers.

initiated_at.description: The timestamp when the wire was initiated

instructed_agent_name.description: Name of the instructed financial institution.

instructed_agent_routing_number.description: Routing number of the instructed financial institution.

instructing_agent_name.description: Name of the instructing financial institution.

instructing_agent_routing_number.description: Routing number of the instructing financial institution.

is_incoming.description: Indicates whether the wire transfer was incoming ( `true` or outgoing `false` )

is_on_us.description: Indicates whether the wire transfer was between two bank accounts held at Column

manual_review_at.description: The timestamp when the wire went into the manual review state

omad.description: Stands for Input/Output Message Accountability Data. A unique number set by the Fed given to each Fedwire payment when using the Federal Reserve Bank Service and can be used to investigate and track wire transfers. OMAD will be populated asynchronously and will not be populated on the completed event. OMAD will also not be populated for on-us wire transfers.

originator_account_number.description: The external account number from which the wire is originated

originator_name.description: The name of the person or entity that is originating the wire

pending_submission_at.description: The timestamp when the wire was marked PENDING_SUBMISSION

pre_review_at.description: The timestamp at which transfer approval became required for the wire transfer, which then waits for an approval decision before being initiated. Only set when transfer approvals are enabled for the platform, or for the API key that created the transfer.

previous_message_reference.description: The previous message identifier included in the raw wire message

raw_beneficiary_address.description: The unstructured beneficiary address extracted from the raw wire message

raw_message.description: The raw Fedwire message for this wire transfer.

raw_originator_address.description: The unstructured originator address extracted from the raw wire message

receiver_di_name.description: The name of the person / entity that received the wire

receiver_di_routing_number.description: The routing number of the bank that received the wire

rejected_at.description: The timestamp when the wire was rejected

return_additional_info.description: Contains additional freeform text from the RDFI if provided (only populated for wire returns)

return_reason.description: Reason the original transfer was returned. Possible values: `invalid_beneficiary_account_number`, `beneficiary_mismatch`, `beneficiary_request`, `originator_request`, `account_closed`, `account_blocked`, `incorrect_amount`, `fraud`, `missing_originator_data`, `missing_beneficiary_data`, `compliance`, `other`.

reversal_pair_transfer_id.description: If the transfer is the original transfer of a wire reversal, this field is the unique ID of the reversal transfer. If the transfer is the reversal transfer of a wire reversal, this field is the unique ID of the original transfer.

reviews.description: The transfer approval decisions recorded on the wire transfer. Each entry is a dashboard user approving or rejecting the transfer while it was in `pre_review`. This list is only populated when transfer approvals are enabled for the platform, or for the API key that created the transfer; otherwise it is omitted from the response.

sender_address.description: The address of the sender of the wire transfer.

sender_di_name.description: The name of the person / entity that sent the wire

sender_di_routing_number.description: The routing number of the bank that sent the wire

sender_reference.description: The sender reference field parsed out from the raw wire message

status.description: The current status of the wire transfer. Possible values: `INITIATED`, `PRE_REVIEW`, `COMPLETED`, `REJECTED`, `MANUAL_REVIEW`, `HOLD`, and `CANCELED`.

submitted_at.description: The timestamp when the wire was submitted

subtype_code.description: The subtype code specified in the wire transfer

tax_record_period_type.description: The Tax Month in the tax remittance component. This field is only required when the counterparty routing number is one of the Treasury tax payment RTNs for an outgoing wire transfer. Possible values are `MM01` through `MM12` (January through December).

tax_type_code.description: Tax Type Code of exactly `5` alphanumeric characters (capital letters and numbers). This field is only required when the counterparty routing number is one of the Treasury tax payment RTNs for an outgoing wire transfer.

tax_year.description: A Tax Year of exactly `4` numerical characters. This field is only required when the counterparty routing number is one of the Treasury tax payment RTNs for an outgoing wire transfer.

type_code.description: The type code specified in the wire transfer

ultimate_originator_counterparty_id.description: ID of the ultimate originating counterparty that sent the transfer in an outgoing wire transfer. If present, this will replace the originator field in the outgoing wire message.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the wire was updated

wire_drawdown_request_id.description: ID of the wire drawdown request if the wire is sent in response to a wire drawdown request

has_more.description: Whether there are more results available after this set.

clearDisbursementRequest.description: Request body for clearing a disbursement hold. Disbursements can only be cleared if they are in a `hold` state. Both fields are optional; if omitted, the original hold amount is used.

amount.description: Updated amount (in cents) of the funds that will be disbursed.

currency.description: The currency of the loan. Currently only `USD` is supported.

updateDisbursementRequest.description: Request body for updating a disbursement hold amount. Disbursement must be in a `hold` state.

amount.description: Amount (in cents) of the funds that will be disbursed.

currency.description: The currency of the loan. Currently only `USD` is supported.

BasicAuth.description: HTTP Basic auth with an empty username and your API key as the password.
